models.notes: 1.8 m exosuit explorer, origin between the feet, faces Godot -Z. Every limb node origin = its joint (Hips at pelvis, Torso at waist, Head at neck, Arm_* at shoulder, Forearm_* at elbow, Leg_* at hip, Shin_* at knee). Rotate about local X for walk swing (rotation.x > 0 swings a hanging limb's far end FORWARD, toward -Z). JetFlame_* origin at the nozzle exit, cone points down (-Y); scale Y to animate. Materials: astronaut_suit/dark/accent(orange team colour, tintable)/glow/visor/gold/flame. Rest pose: relaxed, forearms bent forward ~45 deg.

Hand-held multitool ~0.57 m. Origin at the grip (centre of the handle), barrel along Blender +Y (Godot -Z). Empty 'Muzzle' at the barrel tip (emissive cyan lens). Materials multitool_body/dark/accent(orange)/glow(cyan emissive).

First-person view model built for a camera at the origin looking along Godot -Z (Blender +Y), ~75 deg vertical FOV. FP_Arms = both gloved forearms (white sleeves, dark gloves, cyan wrist screen on the left), FP_Tool = multitool whose origin is the right-hand grip at ~(0.205, -0.225, -0.40) in Godot axes (x right, y up, z forward=-Z), slightly yawed/pitched inward. Muzzle empty (child of FP_Tool) at the barrel tip. Both objects are top-level siblings: parent the whole scene to the camera. Materials fp_viewmodel_body/dark/accent/glow.

Chunky teal/pink bioluminescent grazer, ~2.4 m long. Flat hierarchy: all nodes are top-level siblings under the scene root. Origin = ground contact below the body centre. Body origin at body centre (0, 0.88, 0); Head pivot at the neck (0, 0.99, -0.62 Godot); Tail pivot at the rump; Leg_* pivots at the hips (y=0.80/0.83). Rotate legs about local X for walking (diagonal pairs FL+BR / FR+BL). Materials: _skin (tintable), _belly, _horn, _glow (emissive pink accent, tintable).

Floating bioluminescent jellyfish. Origin = centre of the bell (hover it ~2-4 m above ground). Body = translucent bell (alpha, double-sided) + magenta glow core/rim/canals + 3 oral arms; scale Body in Y/XZ for a pulse. Tentacle_1..6 are top-level siblings with the pivot under the bell rim (r=0.44 m, y=-0.23), rest pose hanging down ~1.6-1.9 m: rotate about local X/Z to sway. Materials: _bell (alpha 0.34), _tentacle (alpha 0.8, purple, tentacle tubes + frilly skirt + oral arms), _glow (emissive, tintable).

Winged flyer, ~2.5 m wingspan, ruby body / orange membrane wings with glowing cyan veins. Flat hierarchy (all top-level siblings). Origin = ground contact below the body centre (the dangling talons touch y=0 when perched; Body pivot at y=0.55). Wing_L/Wing_R pivots at the shoulders (x=+-0.16, y=0.64, z=-0.05 in Godot), exported SPREAD horizontally (slightly raised): flap by rotating about the local forward axis (Godot Z); Wing_R rotation.z>0 raises its tip, Wing_L needs the opposite sign (mirror). Head pivot at the neck, Tail pivot at the tail root (swing about Y/X). Membrane material is double-sided. Materials: _skin, _belly (beak/belly), _membrane, _bone, _glow (emissive).

~0.8 m armoured beetle: amber shell, dark legs, lime glowing stripes/eyes/knees. Flat hierarchy (all top-level siblings). Origin = ground contact below the body centre (Body pivot y=0.28). Leg pivots at the body attachment (x=+-0.2, y=0.27); leg numbering for a tripod gait (i%2 groups): 1=LF 2=RF 3=RM 4=LM 5=LB 6=RB (L=-X, R=+X; in Godot front=-Z). Rotate legs about local X for stepping (and Z to lift). Head pivot at the neck. Materials: _shell (tintable), _plate, _dark, _glow (emissive lime, tintable).
